input.command:
python3 -c "
# Check floor lamp pole and bottle in obs_0035:
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0035.png'))

# Floor lamp pole center:
for r in [350, 400, 450, 500]:
    pole_cols = [c for c in range(330, 400) if abs(int(img[r,c,0]) - int(img[r,c,1])) < 10 and img[r,c,2] > img[r,c,0] and img[r,c,0] < 100]
    if pole_cols:
        print(f'Lamp pole row {r}: center = {(pole_cols[0]+pole_cols[-1])/2:.1f}')

# Bottle in obs_0035:
bottle_cols = []
bottle_rows = []
for r in range(img.shape[0]):
    for c in range(img.shape[1]):
        if img[r,c,2] > 100 and img[r,c,0] < 50:
            bottle_cols.append(c)
            bottle_rows.append(r)

print(f'Bottle cols: [{min(bottle_cols)}, {max(bottle_cols)}], rows: [{min(bottle_rows)}, {max(bottle_rows)}]')
"
